messages:
emily-cs: Heads up — FinEdge AP blocked INV-2026-004. They say the invoice is missing PO language and the VAT handling should be reverse-charge. They're also requesting Net60 instead of Net30. Can we escalate?

raj-finance: Please paste the invoice link and their PO number so we can review.

emily-cs: Customer attached PO in the ticket: `PO-98765-FE`. Invoice URL: https://billing.redwood.local/invoices/INV-2026-004.pdf

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-004 created 2026-03-09 — amount EUR 72,400, VAT=0.00 EUR, note=none.

neha-support: Quick Q — did their card decline initially or did they switch to PO right away?

emily-cs: Card declined (expired). AP requested PO to process, but now they're refusing payment because invoice lacks reverse-charge text and buyer VAT ID.

sophie-legal: For EU B2B reverse charge we need buyer VAT ID on the invoice and explicit wording such as: "Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the recipient" and include our VAT number. We can reissue once finance confirms the format.

matt-sales: Contract default is Net30 unless sales approved different terms. Did the SOW allow Net60? @olga-sales?

olga-sales: SOW clause 4.2 shows Net45, not Net60. Customer is asking for Net60 now for AP processing convenience.

raj-finance: Policy note: Net60 post-signing requires credit check and VP Finance approval if annual spend > EUR 50k.

emily-cs: Their run-rate on platform is ~EUR 420k. AP says they'll only pay on Net60 with a PO. They provided PO above.

laura-ops: Running credit check now, give me ~20m.

laura-ops: Credit check complete — recommended credit limit EUR 150k, no adverse flags.

raj-finance: With that, we can approve a one-time Net60 for 60 days pending VP sign-off and corrected invoice. Looping in @vp-finance.

vp-finance: I approve a one-time Net60 for FinEdge for 60 days. Conditions: (1) reissue invoice with reverse-charge wording and both VAT IDs, (2) have PO on file (we have PO-98765-FE), (3) get a signed amendment if they want permanent Net60.

emily-cs: I'll ask customer to provide their VAT ID and to sign the amendment for future term changes. Will reissue invoice once finance confirms layout.

billing-bot: Action logged: reissue_pending — user=raj-finance, invoice=INV-2026-004, new_terms=Net60_temp, note=add reverse-charge statement and buyer VAT ID.

raj-finance: Reissued invoice now as INV-2026-004-R1 with reverse-charge wording and both VAT IDs included. Posted here: https://billing.redwood.local/invoices/INV-2026-004-R1.pdf

emily-cs: Customer AP acknowledged receipt and scheduled payment on next run. They also provided VAT ID `DE123456789`.

olga-sales: FYI — if they want permanent Net60, we need a signed amendment plus revenue ops approval. Keep sales looped.

billing-bot: Payment posted 2026-03-19 — amount EUR 72,400, payment_method=PO/ACH, invoice=INV-2026-004-R1.

emily-cs: Payment received and cleared. Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround, closing this escalation. :pray:
